title: Instagram
connectPrompt: Connect Instagram to start earning from your posts.
aboutSubtitle: What we read, and how to remove it
aboutTitle: How Tagly uses your Instagram connection
aboutBody: Tagly uses your Instagram profile information, media, and insights to calculate fair rewards for your content.
aboutDoTitle: What we do with this permission
aboutDo1: Display your Instagram profile information in the app (only for you).
aboutDo2: Get your post, story, and account insights (including aggregated audience data like follower locations and demographics) to calculate fair rewards.
aboutDo3: Display aggregated insights to businesses you've shared (reach, impressions, and more). Your Instagram account is never publicly linked to these insights.
aboutNever1: We never post on your Instagram account.
aboutNever2: We never edit your Instagram account.
aboutNever3: We never send messages from your Instagram account.
aboutNever4: We never see your Instagram password or private messages.
aboutSettingsNote: You can change these permissions any time in your Instagram or Meta settings.
aboutManageData: Manage or delete your Instagram data
confirmBody: This deletes your audience data and cancels your unpaid shares. Shares that have not been paid out yet will not be paid. Type your handle to confirm.
